caption: The drawing features several decorative architectural elements, all rendered in black ink on a plain beige background. In the upper left corner, there is a horizontal frieze pattern of scrollwork and foliage. Below this, there is a section of architectural molding with dentils, supporting a rectangular panel bordered with a beaded trim, containing a classical urn on a pedestal. The rectangular panel is flanked below by two decorative pilasters with ornate capitals. To the right, there is a rectangular pattern composed of interlacing curved lines and cross-hatching, bordered on one edge by a row of bead-like circles. Beneath this, there is a smaller panel showing a beaded border with a similar urn design to the first, and to its right, a longer horizontal panel with a beaded border containing a central tree flanked by leafy floral arrangements. All elements are highly detailed and evenly spaced within a large outlined rectangle that frames the entire composition.
title: Details of Paneling
